title: Runner capability metadata: each runner declares its prerequisites, signal triggers, blockers, risk, cost, expected evidence output, and follow-up tools
goal: The Adaptive Assessment Planner (backlog-255) cannot score runners intelligently without knowing what each runner needs and produces. Currently runners have no machine-readable capability declaration — the planner would have to hard-code knowledge about every runner. Implement runner capability metadata: for each runner in workers/runners/, create or update a capabilities.json file (or a capabilities() function in runner.py) that declares: { 'name': 'jwt-probe', 'category': 'authentication', 'risk_tier': 'active', 'required_approvals': 1, 'estimated_minutes': 8, 'triggers': ['jwt_in_response', 'authorization_bearer_header', 'access_token_in_cookie'], 'weak_triggers': ['api_endpoint_present'], 'blockers': ['no_web_target', 'no_http_service'], 'prerequisites': ['phase1_recon_complete'], 'expected_evidence': ['jwt_algorithm_confusion', 'weak_jwt_secret', 'none_algorithm_accepted'], 'follow_up_tools': ['auth-flow'], 'cost': 'low', 'false_positive_rate': 'low', 'description': 'Tests JWT algorithm confusion, weak secrets, and claims manipulation on JWT-protected endpoints.' }. For sqlmap specifically: 'triggers': ['injectable_parameter_found', 'sql_error_in_response', 'form_with_post_action'], 'blockers': ['no_injectable_parameter', 'no_web_forms'] — meaning sqlmap REQUIRES at least one concrete trigger signal, NOT just PHP+MySQL detection. The metadata is loaded at startup into a RunnerRegistry. The planner reads RunnerRegistry to score each runner against the SignalProfile. Create capabilities metadata for all 47 runners. The metadata is the single source of truth for what each runner needs — no more scattered knowledge in planning code.
scope: ChatGPT review 2026-05-06: 'Runner metadata — each tool must declare prerequisites, triggers, blockers, risk, cost, expected evidence, follow-up outputs.' This is the critical missing layer between signal fingerprinting and adaptive planning.
generation_reason: ChatGPT identified runner capability metadata as the missing piece — without it the planner cannot score runners based on evidence. Must come before the planner.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only add capability metadata files. Do not change runner logic, profiles, or dispatch. Metadata is additive and informational.

success_criteria: All 47 runners have a capabilities.json or capabilities() declaration.
RunnerRegistry loads all metadata at startup.
sqlmap metadata requires injectable_parameter OR sql_error signal — not PHP+MySQL alone.
jwt-probe metadata lists jwt_in_response as primary trigger.
deserialization-probe metadata lists java_indicators as primary trigger.
Each metadata entry has: triggers, blockers, prerequisites, expected_evidence, follow_up_tools, estimated_minutes.
RunnerRegistry accessible via API endpoint GET /api/v1/runners/capabilities.
No regression in existing runner tests.

acceptance_criteria: sqlmap triggers require concrete parameter evidence.
